chunks: To God belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He creates whatsoever He wills, bestows daughters on whosoever He will, and gives sons to whom He chooses.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's creation of sons and daughters?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to affirm God's absolute creative power (Qudrah) and His wisdom in bestowing progeny, linking the distribution of genders to divine decree (al-Qadr). It underscores that the capacity to have children is a direct gift from Allah, reinforcing the concept of Tawhid in creation and serving as a reminder of human dependence on the Divine Will.
